responsibility: This file implements GCC’s core RTL simplification and canonicalization engine. It provides the routines that fold unary, binary, relational, and subreg operations on RTL constants and expressions, normalize commutative forms, reason about mode sign bits and constant-pool references, build and simplify vector constants, and support many backend and optimization passes with reusable expression-folding logic. It also contains extensive selftests for scalar and vector simplification behavior. Its responsibility is target-independent RTL algebraic simplification rather than pass-specific transformation orchestration.
